character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist throughout this theme's entire music video: soft black mullet with a subtle blue sheen, warm brown eyes, with a distinct recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a late-night radio host and amateur synth musician on the waterfront. Signature outfit: a pastel windbreaker over a white tee, pleated trousers, and retro sneakers. Unique personal keepsake or tool: a portable cassette player with custom neon headphones. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: Keep this theme's named visual identity as one fixed protagonist across every scene.
Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume, distinctive accessories, and defining personal item without random redesign.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in coastal expressway at dusk, retro city boulevard, neon-lit record shop; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with teal blue, magenta, warm amber, midnight navy; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by cinematic wide shot, tracking shot beside a retro car, close-up portrait with city bokeh; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
